title: An operator named-root release sends no notice to a still-present naming session
outcome: When an operator release removes a root whose naming session is still present (quiet), that session is told once, like a canonical retirement's Reclaimed notice. It can then rename before measured work instead of silently falling back to its ordinary workdir.
acceptance: An operator release of a root whose naming session is present delivers that session a once-only notice naming the released selection, through the same delivery path as retirement notices (refresh_engram_source_root_notices_locked)
A test releases a quiet present session's root by the operator route and asserts the notice is delivered once
